AP_RISING_STRENGTH.title: Rising Strength
AP_RISING_STRENGTH.description: Elites and bosses start each combat with 1 [gold]Strength[/gold] in Act 2 and 2 [gold]Strength[/gold] in Act 3.
AP_ESCALATING_BUFFS.title: Escalating Buffs
AP_ESCALATING_BUFFS.description: Enemies start combat with one random buff in Act 2 and two different ones in Act 3: 1 [gold]Strength[/gold], 4 [gold]Plating[/gold], 2 [gold]Thorns[/gold], 1 [gold]Artifact[/gold], 3 [gold]Regen[/gold], 4 [gold]Curl Up[/gold], 4 [gold]Vigor[/gold] or 1 [gold]Slippery[/gold].
AP_SHRINKING_RESTS.title: Shrinking Rests
AP_SHRINKING_RESTS.description: Resting heals 25% of your Max HP in Act 2 and 20% in Act 3, instead of 30%.
AP_MOUNTING_CURSES.title: Mounting Curses
AP_MOUNTING_CURSES.description: Gain a random curse at the start of Act 2 and of Act 3.
AP_MOUNTING_BANES.title: Mounting Banes
AP_MOUNTING_BANES.description: Gain an [gold]Ascender's Bane[/gold] at the start of Act 2 and of Act 3.
AP_ACT_SCALING.title: Act Scaling
AP_ACT_SCALING.description: Enemies have {Act2Percent}% more Max HP and deal {Act2Percent}% more damage in Act 2, and {Act3Percent}% more in Act 3.
AP_SLOW_START.title: Slow Start
AP_SLOW_START.description: Draw 1 fewer card on the first turn of each combat.
AP_FRAIL_START.title: Frail Start
AP_FRAIL_START.description: Start the run with 10% less Max HP.
AP_DANGEROUS_UNKNOWNS.title: Dangerous Unknowns
AP_DANGEROUS_UNKNOWNS.description: ? rooms lean towards fights. Combat starts at 20% and rises 15% each time a ? room is not a fight. [gold]Elites[/gold] start at 0% and rise 4%. Chests start and rise at 1%.
AP_EXTRA_ASCENDERS_BANE.title: Extra Ascender's Bane
AP_EXTRA_ASCENDERS_BANE.description: Start the run with an extra [gold]Ascender's Bane[/gold].
